requirements:
This model describes a file system.
It represents oily system elements which can be a folders or files. All file system elements have a name. Every file system element must belong to a folder, and folders can aggregate any number of file system elements. Files have information about their extension and their size.

issues.message: The intermediate UML model does not correctly represent the relationship between a Folder and its children. The relationship should be 'Folder has many FileSystemElement' instead of 'FileSystemElement <<aggregates>> FileSystemElement'. This is missing in the PlantUML output as well.
issues.evidence: Requirements state that folders can aggregate any number of file system elements, but this is not correctly represented in the intermediate model and PlantUML output.
suggestions: Update the intermediate UML model to reflect 'Folder has many FileSystemElement' and update the PlantUML accordingly. The relationship should be a 'has many' relationship from Folder to FileSystemElement.
